rIsOGRAPH machine

Our Risograph machine is available for rental by experienced Riso printers.

*Penumbra facilities are available to be rented by MEMBERS ONLY.

Not a member? Become one today!

WHAT’S INCLUDED?

  • 2 drum Risograph machine

  • iMac workstation connected to the machine

  • 6 inks to choose from: black, white, purple, red, yellow, and gold

  • Prints up to 11 x 17 can be produced (10.5 x 16.5 print size)

    Printers must provide their own paper.

nodes.html:
RESERVE YOUR SPOT!

  • $25/ hour rental fee

  • Please note that the base rental cost only covers use of equipment. An additional fee of $1 per master and $0.05 per print ($0.15 for white or gold ink) will be charged after the rental.

  • A 3 hour riso tutorial is required for those with no experience as well as those who have prior experience but not on our Risograph machine.

  • 3 hour private tutorial fee is $300. Group tutorials can be arranged upon request.

  • Please email info@penumbrafoundation.org for scheduling and inquiries.
If you have any questions about renting our facilities, please reach out to info@penumbrafoundation.org
